items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Everybody tipped off the bus, Alfred, Louie, and everybody else tipped off the bus.

ctx.x: You passed right by a cemetery?

I don't know. Well, with this road you passed right by a cemetery. So I had the bus driver, old Paul was sleeping right by the window. He was like, hey, what's the job? He said, you look like a light on that tomb, that tomb right there. Got that spotlight right to that tomb. Nick got over there, got over to the cemetery, fixed that sheet over. Everybody tipped off the bus, Alfred, Louie, and everybody else tipped off the bus. And they got the tomb ready, the light is spotlights right on that tomb. So when they…
Yeah, take it away. Uh, all right. We want some more things, shall we tell you or shall we call down, please? Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down.
